mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 5.25% in a single month reduces near-term discount rates, lowering the present value of expected future cash flows for equities and thereby depressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.25% in a single month
regime_hint: Rising Fed Funds rate surprise in a restrictive policy regime
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns show no statistically significant negative relationship with the FEDFUNDS surprise (p > 0.05 in OLS), or the discount rate sensitivity (Rank IC) is below 0.05 over the 20-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation rate exceeds 0.3% for two consecutive months, investors anticipate a faster than expected rate cut cycle, which boosts equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: High inflation persistence preceding policy rate cuts
failure_condition: Over 60-day horizon, 20-day forward returns show no positive excess return relative to a 0.3% inflation threshold (p > 0.05), or the IC remains below 0.1.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in PAYEMS (labor market strength) accompanied by a decline in UNRATE (labor participation) signals a tight labor market that supports wage growth and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above UNRATE in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically positive after controlling for both PAYEMS and UNRATE (p > 0.05), or interaction rank IC < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in GDPC1 (real private consumption) of at least 2% followed by a rebound above trend suggests a bottom in economic activity, which often precedes a positive S&P 500 20-day forward return.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 drops ≥ 2% in a month and rebounds above 12-month moving average in the following month
failure_condition: No significant positive return in 20 days after such a pattern (p > 0.05), or IC < 0.1.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO (industrial production) of 3% or more for three consecutive months indicates supply-side weakness that can depress corporate earnings expectations and drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls ≥ 3% for three consecutive months
regime_hint: Structural supply shock or contractionary trend
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns after such an INDPRO pattern are not statistically negative (p > 0.05), or IC > -0.1.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 3.0% for two consecutive months while PAYEMS remains flat, it indicates a labor market cooling that reduces upward wage pressure and corporate risk appetite, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 3.0% for two consecutive months and PAYEMS does not rise
regime_hint: Labor market moderation in a growth cycle
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically negative after controlling for the UNRATE-PAYEMS interaction (p > 0.05), or interaction IC > -0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in RSAFS (money supply growth) below -0.5% for three months suggests deflationary pressures that can erode equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: Deflationary momentum in a growth slowdown
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns after such RSAFS behavior are not significantly negative (p > 0.05), or IC > -0.1.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly rise in HOUST (housing starts) exceeding 1.5% above the prior quarter's average, in the absence of a corresponding spike in CPIAUCSL, often precedes optimism about future demand and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > (prior quarter HOUST avg) + 1.5% and CPIAUCSL does not rise > 0.3% in the same month
regime_hint: Residential demand acceleration without price inflation
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive after controlling for the HOUST-CPIAUCSL interaction (p > 0.05), or interaction IC < 0.05.
